question: With a punch-capable action space and lean-proof shaping, do landed strikes emerge, and does the result beat the frozen v0.0.11 champion with a 95% lower bound above zero?
classification: diagnostic self-play; AGENTS.md boxing gates remain unmet; no claim of boxing competence
owner_requirement: gb_feedback_0012: preregister a strike-emergence metric and an Elo gain vs the v0.0.11 frozen opponent with CI lower bound > 0

rules.attribution: grokbot-ending-reference-v2 (strikes need approach and referee active glove speed >= 0.5 m/s)
rules.anti_stalling: grokbot.endings.anti_stalling (no landed strike and no points -> no contest)

measurements_before_training: reach synergy discovery: DynSyn groups 58 (right) / 81 (left) move the hand ~0.20 m forward, 0.18 m up vs trunk in 0.2 s; 57/80 ~0.16 m

fixed punches (gen4 posture + reach groups, onsets 0/200/400 ticks): 0 strikes at 0.7 and 0.6 m; closest own-hand to opponent head/trunk origin 0.596 m at 0.6 m (gloves ~0.35-0.45 m short of target shells)

policy.kind: grokbot.motor_primitives.PunchPolicy (140 LinearPolicy params + per-arm punch onset/duration/amplitude on REACH_GROUPS)
policy.init: punch_params(v0.0.11 gen4, onset=-3.0, duration=0.0, amplitude=2.0): onset ~28 ticks, duration 300 ticks, amplitude ~0.76

training.learner: grokbot.selfplay antithetic ES with common random numbers; P4 sampler; frozen v0.0.11 gen4 added to anchors
training.shaping_key: extension (max own-hand forward displacement relative to own trunk; whole-body lean scores 0)
training.training_only_terms: shaping and strike bonus never enter evaluation, gating or Elo

evaluation.opponents: every earlier checkpoint, the scripted panel and frozen v0.0.11 gen4 (name v11gen4)
evaluation.paired_samples: side-swapped pairs sharing a seed count once (12 per opponent)

metrics.strike_emergence: share of the generation's evaluation bouts in which the candidate landed a strike (classified strike contact by its own glove)
metrics.gain_vs_v11: one-sided 95% Hoeffding lower bound on the paired mean utility vs v11gen4 (12 pairs); requires mean > ~0.71 to exceed 0

gates.promotion: grokbot.promotion.decide against the champion, min_valid 12, engagement gate 0.25

success_criterion: v0.0.13 is a level-up iff at least one generation has strike_emergence >= 0.25 AND gain_vs_v11 lower95 > 0
pre_declared_failure_readings: strikes emerge but lower95 <= 0: striking costs balance (the striker falls first); next lever is stance/recovery after the punch
no strikes: the punch primitive cannot close the reach deficit; next lever is a forward step/lean primitive or the pretrained locomotion bridge
limitations: linear posture policy without opponent observations
0.60 m reset is a grokbot candidate variant
